detached_structure.evidence: A small reddish-roofed attached or adjacent section on the east side of the central house, which may be a porch, deck or addition rather than a separate building.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray gabled roof that looks uniform and in decent shape; a large tree canopy to the northeast shades part of the yard, and a gravel or dirt drive runs along the south side toward the road.
